# Error Message Style Guide

Write clear and helpful error messages.

## Principles
- Say what happened
- Say why it happened
- Say how to fix it
- Be specific, not generic

## Examples
Bad: "An error occurred"
Good: "Could not save file 'report.pdf': disk is full. Free up space and try again."

## Tone
- Be empathetic, not blaming
- Use plain language
- Avoid technical jargon for user-facing errors
